description: This Java class 'GenericFileFilter' is a custom implementation extending 'FileFilter' for filtering files based on extensions in a Swing file chooser component.

classes.name: GenericFileFilter
classes.description: A custom file filter for use in Swing file chooser dialogs that filters files based on their extensions and provides a descriptive label.

methods.name: GenericFileFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with a description and a list of extensions.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether the given file should be shown based on its extension or if it is a directory.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Extracts and returns the file extension in lowercase from the provided File object.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Adds a new extension to the filter's list of accepted extensions.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly description of the file filter, including the list of extensions if configured to do so.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description string for the filter.

methods.name: setExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Sets whether the extensions are included in the description text.

methods.name: isExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Indicates whether the extension list is included in the description.
